visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair and a black sweatshirt sits in the driver's seat of a stationary car at night. Next to him, a woman with long reddish-brown hair wearing a grey striped tank top looks at her phone. The car interior is dimly lit with blue accent lights along the center console. (2) The woman suddenly reaches into the back seat and pulls out a white 7-Eleven plastic bag. She aggressively swings the bag at the man's head and face multiple times. He tries to shield himself with his hands while she continues the physical assault with the plastic bag. (3) The woman reaches back again and produces a green glass bottle, pretending to take a drink. She then suddenly throws green confetti from the bottle onto the man, who sits frozen with green bits in his hair. She yells at him while grabbing more white plastic bags from the rear.
